title: Dependency declared with a caret inside a zero major line
description: package.json declares a caret range inside a `0.x` line, where npm only allows patch-level movement. Consumers expecting minor updates never receive them, so fixes that ship in the next minor stay out of the build while the range reads as a normal caret.
remediation: State the minor version explicitly and review each upgrade.
limitation: It matches a caret range inside a `0.x` line, where npm only allows patch-level movement in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
